notes.title: Game released now!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Astrozombies[/b] is finally out![/h1]
[h2]We are proud to announce the release of our very first game.[/h2]

[b]Astrozombies[/b] is a modern take on the classic action & platforming games we grew up with, presented with a unique 2D aesthetic. Jump right into the action with simple controls, and make your way through challenging levels with some kick-ass music. Hope you like playing it as much as we enjoyed developing it.

Run right and kill everything,
[b]Robot Atomico[/b]

notes.title: Demo update: v1.06 released!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Those of you who have downloaded the Astrozombies demo might've noticed we've applied several updates over the two-month timespan since its original release, mostly adding a couple small fixes and tweaks here and there. However, we didn't actually release any sort of patchnotes to let you know what changed with each new build, so we intend to finally remedy that with these patchnotes.

The biggest change you might notice in v1.06 is the addition of the graphics settings menu, which can only be accessed from the main menu for now, but finally allows you to set the game's resolution and swap between fullscreen and windowed modes at will.

Other than that, most other changes are bugfixes, but there's also a couple balance changes we've done to make the Gravekeeper boss fight at the end of Stage 1 more threatening, while simultaneously removing a couple frustrating elements from the fight (read: you won't have to worry about it somehow killing you after you've already reduced its health to zero). A similar fix was also applied to prevent the Old King's bouncing scythe from staying around even after the boss was defeated in some very specific circumstances.

[h2]Changelog up to Demo v1.06:[/h2]
[h3]Added features:[/h3]
[list][*]Graphics settings sub-menu: Can now set the screen resolution and fullscreen display settings
[*]The game's version number can now be seen  on the main menu
[*]The mouse cursor now stays disabled while playing the game
[*]Spook parts now use a unique sound effect, instead of sharing the same SFX as checkpoints[/list]
[h3]Gameplay changes:[/h3]
[list][*]Stage 1: Lowered Gravekeeper idle intervals, normalized the number of bite attacks it uses regardless of remaining HP, and disabled contact damage to the player 
[*]Stage 2: Fixed certain teleporters' portal VFX not being properly disabled after use
[*]Stage 2: Fixed a bug that caused the Old King's bouncing scythe attack to spawn after the boss' death under certain circumstances[/list]
[h3]General fixes:[/h3]
[list][*] Audio settings now persist between game sessions
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the 'Continue' option to not show up under certain circumstances
[*]Fixed the Robot Atomico logo being scaled incorrectly
[*]Navigation and graphics fixes to the Zombiepedia
[*]Enemy kill counts are now hard-capped to prevent overflows
[*]Removed postprocess screen filters from the "Thanks for playing" screen[/list]

That's all for today, but stay tuned for more updates (and patchnotes) in the future!

notes.title: Game demo released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We're very excited to announce that the game demo is finally available for download!

As the lone survivor of the Astrozombies' attack on Earth, you'll take the fight to their home planet in order to exact your revenge. Remember: [b]Astrozombies must be destroyed![/b]

[h3]Demo contents:[/h3]
[list][*] [u]The first two stages of the game:[/u] The arid wastelands of the [b]Burial Grounds[/b], and the labyrinthine [b]Ancient Tomb[/b]
[*] [u]The Zombiepedia:[/u] Selectable from the main menu, it contains information on enemies you've defeated
[*] [u]Sound Test:[/u] Selectable from the main menu, you can use it to sit back and enjoy the game's stellar soundtrack at your leisure. And yes, that even includes the music of later stages!
[*] [u]Controller support[/u]
[*] [u]Customizable controls[/u][/list]

While some features such as achievements won't be available in the demo, rest assured that they will be there in the full release.

We hope you enjoy this first peek of what the game has to offer as much as we've enjoyed making it, and please feel free to comment, follow and wishlist the game if you like it!
